comment: Production Cloud SQL consumers owned by the private orca-cloud application tree (auth and API services). These values are published for connection-budget review; the private repository binds every field back to its source in its own CI. Legacy Relay state must be reviewed and migrated separately before any Terraform plan or apply.

sources.authInstances: private apps tfvars: auth service max instances
sources.apiInstances: private apps tfvars: API service max instances
sources.maxConnections: Cloud SQL tier default; no max_connections flag is set
